Release Process
Northwind Labs ships platform-api and platform-web every Tuesday and Thursday. Releases are cut from main and tagged with the calendar version, for example 2026.11.2.
Release checklist
1. All required checks on main are green.
2. The changelog lists every merged pull request since the last tag.
3. Database migrations are backward compatible with the previous release.
4. The release owner announces the release in the platform channel.

Release freeze
A release freeze starts 48 hours before a product launch and ends after the launch review. During a freeze only fixes for incidents of severity 1 or 2 are merged, each with a maintainer approval.
Hotfixes
A hotfix branch starts from the last release tag. It is merged back into main on the same day.

Engineering Handbook
This handbook applies to every engineer at Northwind Labs, remote or in the Lisbon and Toronto offices. It replaces version 2026.1 and takes effect on 1 October 2026.
Code review
Every change reaches main through a pull request. A pull request needs one approving review from a code owner of the repository. Maintainers merge; authors never merge their own pull requests. Reviews are answered within one working day.
Branches
Feature branches are named after the issue, for example feat/142-retry-webhooks. Branches are deleted after the merge. Force pushes to main are blocked for everyone.

Working hours
Core hours are 11:00 to 15:00 in the engineer's local time zone. Meetings outside core hours are optional.
Learning budget
Each engineer has a learning budget of 1,500 USD per calendar year for books, courses and conferences. Requests go to the engineering lead in the people portal.

On-call Runbook
The on-call SRE carries the pager for one week, Monday 10:00 to Monday 10:00 UTC. Acknowledge a page within 5 minutes and open an incident in the incident queue within 15 minutes.
1. Check the status dashboard and the latest deploys.
2. Name an incident lead for severity 1 and 2.
3. Post updates in the oncall channel every 30 minutes.

payments-service returns 503
If payments-service returns 503 errors after a deploy, roll back the deploy with nwctl rollback payments-service. When the error rate stays above 1 percent for 10 minutes after the rollback, page the payments team lead.
Build runners out of disk
Prune the Docker image cache with nwctl runners prune. Runners above 95 percent are drained first.

Security Policy
This policy is owned by the security team of Northwind Labs. Engineers outside the security team see it only through their team lead.
Leaked secrets
A leaked secret is rotated within 1 hour of discovery, by the owning team, with the security engineer on call. The rotation is recorded in a private incident; the secret value is never pasted into chat or issues.

Vulnerability handling
Critical vulnerabilities in dependencies are patched within 72 hours, high ones within 14 days. Security fixes to payments-service are merged only after a second review by the security team.
Access reviews
Repository access is reviewed every quarter by each team lead.
